findings.evidence: Label says "(8 digits)", placeholder says "Must be 8 digits", but no pattern or maxlength attribute
findings.fix: Add `pattern="\d{8}"` and `maxlength="8"` attributes to enforce exactly 8 numeric digits.
findings.violation: The form will accept any input (letters, wrong length) despite promising to validate 8-digit format.
